page_title: CEL 2-4 BAR | Celta Vigo v Barcelona 09/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+7' Substitution. Lamine Yamal leaves the pitch and is replaced by Marc Bernal (Barcelona).
90+4' It's the second caution for Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) and that's the last we'll see of him in this game. There was no other option for Javier Alberola.
90+2' Jones El Abdellaoui (Celta Vigo) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
90+2' The attendance for today's match is 21887.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Miguel Roman (Celta Vigo) was quite harsh and Javier Alberola didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
88' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
88' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) takes a good first touch just outside the box and unloads a shot without any hesitation that bounces off the right post. Not a bad try.
88' Here comes a substitution. Ferran Torres (Barcelona) is brought on as a substitute for Marcus Rashford.
87' This is a yellow card! Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
86' Hansi Flick prepares a substitution. Alejandro Balde is replaced by Gerard Martin (Barcelona).
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Dani Olmo leaves the pitch and Andreas Christensen (Barcelona) comes on.
84' Javier Alberola blows for a foul after Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
82' The corner is swung in but Celta Vigo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
81' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
81' Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
79' Javier Alberola shows a yellow card to Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) for his blatant foul.
78' Here is a change. Manuel Fernandez is going off and Claudio Giraldez gives the last tactical orders to Miguel Roman (Celta Vigo).
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jones El Abdellaoui (Celta Vigo) will replace Hugo Sotelo.

73' 2 - 4 The ball is swung in by Marcus Rashford from the corner kick. He perfectly finds the head of Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona), whose long-range header goes in off the right post to make the score 2:4.
73' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
72' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) trips an opposition player and Javier Alberola signals a foul.
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) comes onto the pitch so that Borja Iglesias can be given a rest.
68' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
68' The corner kick from Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag and Barcelona will take a corner.

67' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) meets a cross just outside the area and gets in a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out of play. Barcelona are awarded a corner kick.
63' Manuel Fernandez (Celta Vigo) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
61' The game is interrupted now, Manuel Fernandez (Celta Vigo) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
59' Javier Alberola blows his whistle and it's Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) comes onto the pitch for Ferran Jutgla.

56' Barcelona are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
52' The game is interrupted as Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) is flagged offside.
51' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) was too forceful with his tackle and Javier Alberola interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
49' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
46' Claudio Giraldez makes a switch. Javier Rodriguez is coming on in place of Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) at the start of the second period.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+7' Javier Alberola has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+4' 2 - 3 Goal! Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:3.
45+2' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Javier Alberola saw the whole situation.
45+1' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

45+1' A lofted cross from Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Barcelona.
45' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

44' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Ionut Radu pulls off an easy save.
43' 2 - 2 Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) scores! He latches on to a pass and produces a perfect strike from the edge of the box that goes into the roof of the net and past the goalkeeper.
42' Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) has tested the patience of referee Javier Alberola and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

37' 1 - 2 It's a goal! Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) scores with a brilliant low shot into the middle of the goal after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Marcus Rashford. The score is now 1:2.
33' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
32' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) fires a volley towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but the ball goes well wide of the left post.
32' Barcelona work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

31' Eric Garcia (Barcelona) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

30' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
25' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and drills a shot to the bottom right corner, but is denied by a reflex save from Ionut Radu.
25' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) fires a rebound from mid-range onto the left post!
19' Barcelona are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
16' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) picks up a sweet pass and fires one in from distance towards the top of the goal, but Wojciech Szczesny is alert and makes a decent save.
15' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) is flagged for offside.

11' 1 - 1 Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Wojciech Szczesny is just a bystander as the ball flies into the bottom left corner. The score is 1:1.
10' 0 - 1 Goal! Ionut Radu gets a hand on the penalty from Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom right corner.
9' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) is going to take the penalty!
9' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Barcelona!

8' Play continues despite the shouts by some Barcelona players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Javier Alberola interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
7' Surely that's handball by one of the Celta Vigo players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
7' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Barcelona are awarded a corner kick.
5' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked.
4' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) attempts to curl the ball over the wall from the free kick, but one of the defenders deflects it away from danger.
3' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) jumps into a tackle and Javier Alberola signals a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Barcelona.
2' Flag goes up against Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
1' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Barcelona will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Javier Alberola.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
